text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock A repeatedly as it rose, but its gains did not prevent the portfolio from falling later; I should reassess concentration and risk across all holdings, not rely on past performance.","I made no trades during two steep monthly declines, then sold Stock C near my average cost; I should review the reasons for holding or selling against a clear plan rather than react to short-term losses.","Adding Stocks C, D, B, and E broadened my holdings, but diversification alone does not prevent losses; I should check whether each position still fits my portfolio goals and risk limits."]}
